name: Smoky Tofu with Mushrooms, Peppers, Tomatoes, Rice & Arugula Salad

instructions.primary_message: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup basmati rice
1 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 caps portobello mushrooms
1 yellow bell pepper
½ (142 g) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut the tofu planks in half, then cut each half into 2 triangles. Place in a medium bowl, sprinkle with cornstarch and spices, then toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp cornstarch
2 tsp smoked paprika
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tofu and cook until golden, 2-3 minutes per side. Remove to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve bowl and skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, remove stems from portobello mushrooms; halve lengthwise, then cut crosswise into ½-inch thick pieces. Place in the reserved bowl.
Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the mushroom.

When the tofu is done, return skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushroom, bell pepper, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp crushed red pepper
¼ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Add tomatoes to the skillet, stir to combine the sauce, and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium and cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender and sauce is thickened slightly, 6-8 minutes. Cover and remove from heat.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper in a clean medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tsp white wine vinegar
½ tsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp pure maple syrup
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Just before serving, add arugula to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
Divide rice, tofu, and sauce between plates or bowls. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
